title: LimoBench: How Street Smart Are Large Language Models?
abstract: arXiv:2611.31682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed how humans interact with information, enabling natural-language interfaces across various domains. They are increasingly deployed for geospatial applications including map-based question answering, location-based services, and natural-language interfaces to spatial databases. But are LLMs truly location-aware, able to reliably interpret and precisely answer location queries involving real-world coordinates, points of interest (POIs), and geospatial distances? translated_title: LimoBench：大语言模型有多“懂”街道？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已经改变了人类与信息交互的方式，实现了跨领域的自然语言交互界面。它们正越来越多地被部署于地理空间应用中，包括基于地图的问答、基于位置的服务，以及空间数据库的自然语言接口。但LLMs是否真正具备位置感知能力，能够可靠地解释并精确回答涉及真实世界坐标、兴趣点（POI）和地理空间距离的位置查询？为了具体回答这个问题，我们提出了LimoBench，一个街道级基准测试，包含82个自然语言位置查询，涵盖七种经典空间操作：地理编码、逆地理编码、路径规划、方向判断、范围搜索、$k$近邻搜索和空间连接。这些查询基于印第安纳州西拉法叶市的真实地图数据构建，并按照位置和语义复杂度进行分级，旨在探测LLM的街道级空间……
tldr: 提出了首个街道级地理空间基准LimoBench，通过82个基于真实地图数据的自然语言位置查询，系统评估大语言模型在地理编码、路径规划、$k$近邻搜索等七种空间操作上的位置感知与精确回答能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce LimoBench, a street-level benchmark of 82 natural-language location queries grounded in real map data, designed to evaluate whether LLMs can reliably interpret and precisely answer location queries across seven canonical geospatial operations.
